scenes: Photorealistic cinematic film still, vertical 9:16, shot on ARRI Alexa with an anamorphic lens, natural light, fine film grain, Neolithic Anatolia around 9600 BC. Prehistoric Homo sapiens wear animal hides and leather, no metal, no pottery, no text, no logos. In a pale limestone quarry on a hilltop at golden hour, a muscular prehistoric stone carver kneels on a giant unfinished T-shaped limestone pillar exactly like the pillars, striking it with a sharp flint hand tool, white stone chips flying, three other workers behind him shaping the stone. Medium shot, low warm sun, dust hanging in the air.

Prehistoric Homo sapiens wear animal hides and leather, no metal, no pottery, no text, no logos. Dozens of prehistoric people pull thick braided ropes and push long wooden levers to raise a colossal T-shaped limestone pillar exactly like the pillars upright inside a ring of rough stone walls on a hilltop. Dramatic dusk sky, dust clouds, low angle wide shot, a sense of enormous weight.
